clips.title: The story
paras: Darkshire sends provisions to Sven Yorgen's camp in northwestern Duskwood. The Carevin family keeps his small band supplied as they hold their watch against the shadows.

Sven Yorgen and his few followers camp in the northwestern wilderness, far from Darkshire. Their numbers are too low, and their watch too demanding, to spare anyone for the journey into town. The Carevin family sends food, bandages, and other necessities to the isolated camp, helping the band hold its ground.
